text:
maria: Noticing a weekend spike in cross-region retries (us-west-2 -> eu-north-1) tied to a routing asymmetry + TLS handshakes failing mid-stream. Opening thread to track follow-ups and owners for remediation + playbook changes.
ops-bot: Incident alert: egress-retry-rate > threshold in prod-us-west-2 at 2026-04-04T02:12Z.
kai: quick summary from preliminary logs: a subset of flows show RST after ServerHello, plus route-nexthop change around the same timestamps. Looks like some NAT devices flipped path -> asymmetric MTU/fragmentation might be involved.
noah: sample logs (short): ```
[02:12:13Z] conn=245876 tls: server hello received; next=10.45.9.2
[02:12:13Z] conn=245876 tcp: RST from 10.45.9.2 length=0
[02:12:14Z] conn=246001 retry scheduled after conn reset
```
anya: we had a similar recurring pattern flagged in previous postmortem (see internal link: infra/notes/egress-patterns). We should capture whether this is the same root cause or a new variant.
maria: proposed action items (please ack & set ETA). Trying to avoid duplicating previous threads' phrasing.
- ITEM-1) Flow-level packet capture on affected NATs and egress proxies for 15m window. Owner: kai. ETA: 2026-04-06.
- ITEM-2) BGP routing snapshot + nexthop timeline for the 02:00-02:30Z window. Owner: noah. ETA: 2026-04-05.
- ITEM-3) Run controlled MTU and fragmentation tests across NAT chain. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-04-07.
- ITEM-4) Short-term rollback to conservative TLS timeout + backoff on affected route (feature flag), canary at 3% -> 20%. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-05 (hotfix).
- ITEM-5) Update egress playbook to include asymmetric routing checks and explicit MTU checks in triage steps. Owner: kai. ETA: 2026-04-12.
- ITEM-6) Postmortem follow-up: correlate this event with last 3 months of egress-retry alerts to identify recurrence cadence. Owner: noah. ETA: 2026-04-10.
- ITEM-7) Security review: temporary acceptance of alternate cert chains during partner rotation windows (if partner rotation implicated). Owner: security-team. ETA: 2026-04-08.
kai: ack ITEM-1 and ITEM-5. I'll attach pcap permalinks once uploaded.
noah: ack ITEM-2 and ITEM-6. I'll pull routers' bgp snapshots and traceroutes.
anya: ack ITEM-3. I'll run end-to-end MTU and will also test with TCPLargeSegments off to simulate fragmentation.
maria: I'll own ITEM-4. Can we plan the canary step today? ops-oncall please confirm availability.
ops-bot: Pager: ops-oncall notified (maria requested) - available for canary 2026-04-04 03:30Z.
kai: uploaded pcap: https://internal-artifacts/pcaps/2187654321-1.pcap (retention 7d). Early look: multiple zero-length RSTs immediately following TLS ServerHello in ~37 flows.
noah: BGP snapshot shows a brief flapping event between two transit providers at 02:12:10Z - likely changed nexthop for eu-north-egress. Correlating with NAT session logs now.
anya: MTU tests show PMTU discovery is behaving but ICMP blackhole suspected on one transit link; when MSS is shaved by proxies we see fragmentation and retransmits.
maria: decision for hotfix: enable conservative TLS handshake timeout and exponential backoff, canary 3% now. Roll to 20% after 10m if signal OK.
maria: also, add temporary retry budget cap to avoid cascading retries causing backend 504s. Owner: maria. ETA: immediate.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: feature/egress-conservative-tls -> 3% traffic (cluster prod-us-west-2).
kai: monitoring: egress-retry-rate moved from 1.4% -> 0.45% in 12m after canary. Some remaining flows still failing.
noah: correlating BGP and NAT session logs shows the remaining failing flows traverse the transit with suspected ICMP blackhole. Escalating to transit provider.
anya: simultaneously we can implement a proxy header-trimming experiment to reduce MSS overhead (small patch). Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-04-11.
security-team: noted on ITEM-7. We'll run a quick risk assessment; provisional OK if partner rotation window documented and thumbprint caching limited to 10m and auditable.
maria: thanks. two quick asks before we close the immediate loop: (1) kai/noah, please attach the pcap and BGP diff to this thread; (2) anya, post MTU test results and exact tc commands you ran.
kai: attached pcap permalink and brief summary.
noah: attached bgp-diff and traceroute matrix. Sent transit provider ticket #TP-4521.
anya: posted MTU probe outputs and tc config used. Will open PR for header trimming experiment.
maria: follow-up plan: keep hotfix until transit provider confirms no blackhole; complete ITEM-1..ITEM-7 and then sync in SRE weekly on 2026-04-11 to decide on permanent mitigations and playbook changes.
noah: I'll provide the recurrence analysis by 2026-04-10. If we see monthly recurrence pattern we may need automated mitigation.
kai: I'll update the playbook with concrete commands and diagnostic checklist (ping, tcptraceroute, tcpdump filters) and link it here when ready.
ops-bot: Incident note: assigned owners updated on 2026-04-04 by maria.
maria: appreciate everyone. Keep this thread as the canonical tracking record. If anyone finds additional correlated events, paste them here rather than opening a new thread for the same symptom.
